reviews.text: It seems complete, full of specialties. I went specifically looking for a dermatologist, Dr. Julia. There's free parking. The place is large and sells medicines and pet food.

Extremely disappointing and frustrating experience with the medical team at Vet Quality Veterinary Hospital. They performed invasive surgical procedures on our dog—who is a cardiac patient and part of our company's team, Jeep Militar—placing his life at extreme risk in the post-operative period due to serious failures in conduct and patient safety. It is outrageous that, even after the hospital itself acknowledged the error, the legal team is trying to mitigate the situation by offering a sum that is nothing more than a pittance compared to everything I have spent and continue to spend to remedy the problem they themselves caused. I will not accept crumbs for the total disregard for the life and health of our work companion.

Lack of respect for pet owners! Terrible service at reception! This is the second time I've waited more than an hour to be seen. I was waiting for an exam for over an hour, and they told me they were going to let people go ahead of me because the person arrived on time.

In addition to the stress the animals go through while waiting, we also get stressed by so much neglect and disorganization!

I frequented this hospital for 3 years and never had a bad experience. They cared for my pet daughter as if she were their own, very attentive, very careful, very loving and VERY qualified!! Thank you for all your care, you will forever be in my heart and prayers with much affection!

I am Pity's owner, and I only have praise for Vetquality veterinary hospital. My dog, a Cocker Spaniel, was admitted to the emergency room with suspected stroke, high blood pressure, motor disturbances in her head, and loss of balance. I received wonderful care from all the highly competent professionals, from the valet parking attendants and receptionists to the committed medical team, especially Dr. Priscila, who cared for her with competence, dedication, and love, and reassured me greatly during the procedures such as the MRI of her skull and cervical spine, with cerebrospinal fluid sampling. She was hospitalized for almost 7 days with daily evaluations, complex tests, and daily medical reports. My dog ​​is doing well, and I can only thank Vetquality Hospital for all their care, competence, and dedication. Thank you all!

I would like to register our deep indignation and disappointment with the care received at this veterinary hospital, specifically from Dr. Paula Cava Rodrigues and Dr. Rodrigo Chapchap Brossi.
I took my dog ​​there seeking professional care, empathy, and attention, but what we experienced was an extremely negligent, omissive, and unprepared attitude on the part of the aforementioned medical team. Unfortunately, the lack of competence and disregard in monitoring the situation resulted in a worsening of the condition, and my dog ​​continues to suffer to this day.
It is unacceptable that pet owners entrust the life and health of their animals to a veterinary establishment and receive such insensitive and unprofessional service. I do not recommend the services of these professionals to anyone who loves their pet and seeks a serious and responsible service.
Unfortunately, these and other people involved in this company are the worst people we have met in Veterinary Medicine.
I hope they are held accountable and that they have respect and compassion for life, especially for animals.
Impeccable professionals and incredibly humanized service!

Today, September 5th, 2026, I went to the emergency room with my dog, who was experiencing respiratory distress.

The service was provided, but it fell far short of expectations, especially considering the amount paid, both for the health insurance and the co-payments charged for each visit. I arrived at the unit around 7 PM, and at that time, the X-ray service was no longer available, which prevented an image evaluation when it would have been most useful.

After the entire consultation, there was no conclusive diagnosis regarding my dog's condition. In other words, he entered with the problem and left with the same problem, without any resolution and without a clear diagnostic definition.

An important aggravating factor: during the episode, his ear and part of his tongue turned bluish, a sign consistent with low oxygenation. Therefore, I believe he should not have been discharged without a conclusive diagnosis and without the condition being, at the very least, managed. The equipment used to measure blood oxygenation malfunctioned, and the oxygen inhaler itself was in poor condition. I was surprised (negatively) by the state of the equipment, given the clinic's standard. Considering this was a brachycephalic dog, respiratory stabilization maneuvers should have been performed to achieve a minimally satisfactory result before discharge, avoiding the risk of sudden deterioration or any complications during the night without veterinary supervision.

Compared to the standard of care this unit offered a few years ago, the difference is evident; the service was significantly more complete and professional. Today, for an extremely high price, the results delivered do not meet expectations for a 24-hour emergency service.

I've been a client of the hospital for about a year, and all the visits have been great for my cats, but I need to highlight today's visit, August 22, 2026.
My kitten needed a facial X-ray, a very simple exam for cats.
Matheus, the radiology technician, was responsible for the exam and was simply perfect. He calmly explained the procedure to us, putting us at ease.
Everything was so calm that we were able to get all the images in one go, without stressing our pet. I left there delighted with Matheus's service.
Excellent service and superb veterinarians.
Everything was very well organized, the staff were skilled and attentive.

On August 3rd, 2026, I was at the clinic around 8:00 AM. The doctor ordered the tests, gave me a quote, and I paid for everything! At the end, the doctor reported that some tests hadn't been done, so I requested a refund! To my surprise... the young man at reception said they would only process the refund after 7 days... and he said this laughing and showing disregard! There's no law in the world that says a refund should be processed after waiting that long, my cat is sick and they're making me wait... I'm only going back because I've already paid for the 3 tests and I want the results! But I don't recommend even passing by this place! Pure commerce and disregard! After a series of ironic remarks made by Mr. Iago, who works for you, this response based on respect doesn't apply; you should send this moral lesson to your employees... who are ironic and disrespectful. Today, August 5th, 2026, I was at this establishment around 9:30 AM for a urine sample to be collected from my cat via cystocentesis. To my surprise, they punctured my cat's abdomen twice, probing as if they were looking for an vein, but the syringe was in his bladder. They claimed there was a layer of fat, and after my cat screamed in pain, they managed to collect 4ml of urine. The woman who collected it said she needed 5ml. What response do you have now? Are we going to talk about disrespect? Are we going to talk about lack of professionalism? Is the professional who attended to my cat even qualified? All these questions will be addressed legally. I WILL NEVER SET FOOT IN THIS ESTABLISHMENT AGAIN.

They charge for a series of services upfront. You pay an absurd amount.
In the end, they say they will refund you for what wasn't done. (????)
The refund takes 7 to 10 business days, depending on the financial institution.
Several clinical exams didn't match my dog's posture.
I sent the exams in real time to the veterinarian who usually evaluates him, and she found it very strange.
She said that based on the exams, he should be much better than he appeared in person.
Conclusion: it seemed like my dog ​​was being intentionally and unnecessarily drugged as a way to force/insist on his staying in the hospital and continue profiting unfairly.
Run away from this "money-grabbing" clinic or mortgage your house so they can "discover" that your dog only has gastroenteritis.
Bizarre…

The professionals are competent, despite their arrogance and haughtiness.
That's tolerable.
What's intolerable is the exorbitant/abusive pricing.
I had to rush my dog ​​to the vet in the middle of the night because he was feeling unwell.
My trusted veterinarian sent the referral with her notes and requests for tests, but the veterinarians at Vet Quality invariably ignored the requests and didn't pay much attention to several warnings from my veterinarian, who has cared for my dog ​​for 3 years and knows him very well.
The veterinarians at Vet Quality requested a countless number of tests (approximately 14) under the justification that they had no clue what was wrong with my dog.
More than half of the tests turned out to be unnecessary in the end.

My trusted veterinarian interpreted the tests much more optimistically than those at Vet Quality; however, the latter always tried to "scare" me, insisting that I keep the dog hospitalized, even when his condition was stable.
They said they needed to continue observing.
Meanwhile, Bidu (my dog) was languishing in the kennel without apparent explanation. The test results definitely didn't match his clinical condition.
They tried to push more tests and more hospitalization. I researched the same tests and procedures in several places, and the price difference is striking. Some tests cost twice as much as the highest prices in the places I researched.
The impression is that I'm dealing with mercenaries who are much more concerned with monetizing the health of pets than actually caring for them, which should be a rule in veterinary medical ethics.
They try at all costs to keep the animals hospitalized for observation, without any apparent or sufficient reason.
The cost of 2 days of hospitalization + exams came to almost R$ 6,000.00.
To top it off, one of the amounts was charged twice to my card.
The only positive point was the finance guy, Jean, who attentively took care of the calculations and said he would request a refund of the positive balance. I will only feel a little more relieved when the incorrect amount is returned to my card.
In short, a terrible and traumatizing experience.
Finally, I noticed that I wasn't the only one who was unhappy.
I heard a series of complaints from other customers in the hallways.
Therefore, the positive reviews of the place surprise me.
He saved my dogs' lives twice. Very careful and a top choice. Have a medical plan so you don't end up spending a fortune there.
We had a consultation with Dr. Bruno, and it was a great pleasure to be seen by someone so attentive and so sure of what he's doing. I recommend him without hesitation!
Bruno is an excellent veterinarian, very efficient and extremely careful. I've had dogs for years and I've never had a veterinarian as good as him.

The best thing that ever happened to me was trusting this clinic. They took better care of my dog ​​than I'm treated in a human hospital. They gave her all the necessary medications, and although a super complex surgery was necessary for her case, they had a competent team, blood bags, and equipment to test compatibility already on site. The anesthesiologist explained everything to me in a very humane way, understanding the seriousness of the situation and how much it affected me. In the end, everything turned out as well as it could have (again, the situation was very serious). It was clear that everyone there did their best to make it happen. If I can see my daughter again today, it's thanks to the actions of these veterinarians and this hospital. Thank you all.
We had to wait 30 minutes while the vet got the medication and prepared the prescription. Why did we have to wait so long?
The service is extremely slow; allow more than 2 hours to wait for the initial appointment and another 3 hours for the tests.

I went to a consultation, and the next day my dog, after being medicated, showed a significant worsening. I contacted the hospital and the doctor asked me to return immediately. I arrived in 10 minutes and waited 1 hour and 30 minutes to be seen with my dog ​​vomiting all over the hospital.

I wasn't seen and had to rush to another emergency room.

I do not recommend it.
They were incredibly careful with my dog. They cared for my beloved pet as if it were their own. I highly recommend them for their professionalism, dedication, and empathy.

Excellent service, the staff loves animals.

Very well-equipped hospital.

One of the best veterinary hospitals in the southern zone.

I recommend it.
Excellent veterinary hospital, very good service and doctors.

My 13-year-old dog was hospitalized. I always use Vet Quality's care and medical professionals for Snow's routine and follow-up. There was a lot of confusing information among the hospitalization professionals; what they told the veterinarians didn't match the information given to me and my husband.
I understood this as a lack of proper management by the nursing staff, from the nurse being afraid (because she was angry and in pain) to them saying we shouldn't bring her food, and telling the veterinarian that we didn't. When we admitted her, they said they would create a WhatsApp group for professionals to talk about Snow with us, but they didn't. Perhaps that was the mistake; everyone involved should have been aware of everything, and so should we.
I am waiting for an answer as to why they didn't give her three medications that the gastroenterologist requested (we bought them on the same day), and today when I went to pick them up, they were sealed. 🫤🫤🫤🫤🫤

The overall experience with Chanel, my 11 year old Maltese was ok. The staff is friendly and very caring but the service is very slow. It took us more than 2 hours between checking in with doctor and make a ultrasound.

Terrible service during the night. My uncle took his cat in with only vomiting symptoms, and they ordered a million tests that, in principle, weren't screening tests, and they didn't order the main tests for an elderly cat, which would be liver and kidney function tests.
I've been bringing my 4-year-old dog here regularly since she was a puppy. All the professionals are highly qualified, with special mention to Gabi Moreno and the nurse Leandro, who are exceptional!

Hello Fabio, we regret that your experience was not positive. If you would like to make any further comments about your experience at Vet Quality, please contact our ombudsman directly at ouvidoria@petcare.com.br. We will be happy to hear from you!

I went to the emergency room of this clinic because it was the closest to where I was. My Spitz was having a tracheal collapse crisis. He had to be hospitalized, and they immediately gave me a quote of R$3,600.00.
I said it was to resolve what was urgent. He stayed there overnight, and I paid almost R$2,600.00. When I got home, I realized the dog still had the IV line. They made me leave home to have the line removed at another clinic, which stressed the animal again and triggered another crisis. I reported what happened, and they told me to find a veterinarian to see what was causing the crises. The crisis was caused by the stress you provoked!!!
Zero attention, zero empathy, and zero responsibility!

As it is a veterinary hospital, the flow and availability vary depending on the number of emergencies, but we have always been treated very well, the place has always been organized and the professionals very attentive.
The Vet Quality team was very attentive. My dog ​​underwent surgery and was hospitalized. The service was excellent. It's a quality clinic that accepts Petlove insurance.

The on-site service is excellent. The veterinarians and nursing staff are very good and attentive. There is free parking on-site, which is very convenient. The only problem, and what prevents me from giving the establishment five stars, is that the entire telephone contact system is TERRIBLE! It's practically impossible to get through to anyone, as no one answers, the phone system drops constantly, calls don't go through, and the website is difficult to access for obtaining test results. This entire section regarding the results website and telephone access needs to be revamped as a matter of urgency, because out of every 10 attempts to contact Vet Quality, I'm lucky to get through only once.

I am immensely grateful for the treatment given to my Billy. From the moment he arrived and throughout his hospitalization, the veterinarians were excellent, especially Dr. Gabriela.
However, the administrative side is very confusing. They keep passing the buck, no one guides us properly, in short, it's regrettable!

The airport was extremely crowded on the day of the trip, which caused discomfort. There were not enough seats available and the queue management seemed disorganized. Even so, the infrastructure managed to meet the demand without major flight delays.

Dr. Matheus operated on my dear Bethy, both of her kneecaps. He was very caring with her and very attentive to us. He made me feel super calm. 😍
Dr. Matheus, thank you so much for taking care of Bethy with so much affection and dedication. Seeing her recovery fills my heart with relief and gratitude. …
My dog ​​only gets treated there, excellent professionals!!!!! There's a super doctor I really like, Dr. Mateus, an excellent orthopedic professional!!!! 1000 out of 10 for him!!!!

Good morning Daniella. Thank you so much for highlighting our hospital with your positive feedback and 5-star rating. Our goal is to offer the best veterinary medicine and care to our clients. Have a great week everyone.

The doctors are great, but the reception is a complete mess. We schedule exams and appointments and they don't contact us to confirm, which is outrageous for clients. We've had this kind of negative experience more than once.
Allan, your feedback inspires us and reinforces our commitment to quality veterinary medicine. Thank you very much for your trust! Merry Christmas to you and your family!

My pug puppy had a respiratory problem. I was on the road far from São Paulo and had to choose an ICU "blindly" to treat him urgently.
I can't even describe the care that Dr. Vitória, Dr. Luana, and Dr. Caio provided for my puppy. It was excellent! They were so serious and caring, both for him and for me, who was far away and distressed. Including the issue of budgets and costs. Everything was always very clear, without surprises.
I am immensely grateful for everything. How good it is to know that if my furry children need you, you will be there!

An excellent hospital, I want to congratulate the entire team. My cat had surgery there and I was very well taken care of when I ate her food.

God bless you greatly.
Excellent! Dr. Amanda is extremely competent and attentive to both the family and the pet.

Dr. Matheus Caparroz, orthopedist:
Bella presented with spinal problems at only 1 year old. Dr. Matheus helped us wean her off medication and treat her correctly with physiotherapy and acupuncture. Today, she has a healthy life and is not dependent on medication.
Following the spinal episode, she tore a ligament in her knees, and the doctor conducted the treatment, surgery, and post-operative care with excellence and great care.
The entire process, from diagnosis and exams to surgery and post-operative care, was done with great professionalism and gave us a lot of confidence.
The veterinary hospital is fully equipped to perform all types of exams.
Your feedback inspires us and reinforces our commitment to quality veterinary medicine. Thank you very much for your trust!

I've been a Vet Quality client for about 5 years and have always had great experiences. The hospital has an excellent structure, it's clean, organized, and the service is very good—they always answer questions via WhatsApp or phone with great attention.

Throughout this time, my pet, Loki, has been treated by various specialists, and all the professionals, without exception, have contributed greatly to his health. When we started treatment, he was obese and had severe allergies. Today, thanks to the work of the multidisciplinary team, he is a healthy dog. I really like how the veterinarians communicate with each other, ensuring complete care.

I would like to highlight some professionals who made (and continue to make) all the difference:

Dr. Mateus Caparroz (Orthopedist) – Operated on Loki in October 2025 in an elective surgery. He was extremely attentive and calm in explaining the entire procedure, always making clear the risks of not operating and the reasons for the indication. In the post-operative period, he continues to closely monitor and answers all questions with great patience and empathy.

Dr. Júlia Severo (Dermatologist) and Dr. Cecília (Nutritionist) – They were the first to treat Loki and completely improved his quality of life. Before, he lived with wounds all over his body, constant ear infections, itching, and was very overweight. They were able to identify the foods that caused his allergies and always provide assistance when necessary. They are extremely helpful, careful, and committed.

Dr. Caio Marchi (Pulmonologist) – He follows Loki's condition due to tracheal and bronchial collapse. He is very attentive, performs regular checkups, and maintains an effective medication treatment.

Dr. Maiara (Dentist) – She has already performed two tartar cleanings on Loki. The procedures were smooth, and she always calmly explains how to prevent buildup.

Dr. Gabi Matos (Cardiologist) – Extremely careful and prudent with treatment. She is very concerned about Loki's cardiac health, especially before procedures with general anesthesia.

In short, we are very grateful to the entire Vet Quality team. The service is excellent in all areas, including emergencies.
I recommend them without hesitation!

Excellent clinic, good physical structure and quality service, a skilled and compassionate technical team! I want to express our gratitude to the entire Vet Quality team who took care of our dog Leonardo. We had an unforeseen event; we're not from São Paulo, we were in the city for work, and our dog needed to be hospitalized for 5 days, which was a big scare. Exceptionally, on the first day of hospitalization, we had a communication failure that was promptly resolved. We want to thank all the veterinarians who cared for him, from the emergency room to his hospitalization: Drs. Giovanna, Brenda, Tais, Gastroenterologist Gabriela, Hematologist Jessica, and all the other doctors we didn't have formal contact with but who also cared for him, the reception, and the security and cleaning staff. Thank you very much! ❤️

A wonderful and very well-structured hospital. Excellent veterinary care. Clinical, surgical, ICU, ER – everything is of excellent quality. The reception staff is extremely polite and well-trained. I have been using the hospital for years and each day I have a more positive experience. I will always be eternally grateful to this institution! And I will always recommend it. The professionals and management all deserve congratulations!
